assessment: While it has been demonstrated that for SARS-CoV-2, a small fraction of individuals contributes to the majority of onward transmission, this heterogeneity is driven by multiple factors that span both biological and behavioral causes. By performing a solid meta-analysis of household transmission studies, the authors fit a household transmission model to the curated data to estimate variation in infectiousness which provides a valuable contribution to the existing knowledge base. By collating data from multiple studies, they are able to more fully investigate individual variability.
